_comment: Auto-pilot policy object. Ships EMPTY and DISABLED on purpose. While enabled=false (or a (canonical_key, provenance) has no entry) every asking widget resolves to queued_unknown and NOTHING is auto-answered. AUTHORING DISCIPLINE: never hand-write a canonical_key here. Add entries only via `node app/lib/replay.js <project> --scaffold <asking_event_id>`, which keys the entry off exactly what the classifier emitted for a real logged capture. Policy authoring is a selection over the corpus, not a specification from scratch; a key typed by hand that the classifier never emits is a silent never-matches bug. After any classifier or policy change, run `node app/lib/replay.js <project>` and read the diff before shipping. dispatched and autonomous are INDEPENDENT tables, not an inheritance hierarchy: a prompt safe autonomously may be one you want to confirm yourself under dispatch, and vice-versa. Use the diff between them as an audit artifact.
